overall_rationale: All three must needs (N1, N2, N3) are met only with conditions, so the overall verdict is feasible_with_conditions. N1 depends on the internal station feed (access approval and VR-03 gap handling) for production, and on the UCI file for the prototype. N2 depends on the internal traffic counts, which need the counter break and station mapping resolved. N3 depends on Open-Meteo, which needs its point confirmed and mixed licence cleared. N4 (should) is met with conditions via the clinic table. N5 (could) is unmet and N6 (could) is partial. Actions: request the Environment Monitoring Unit, Mobility Office and Clinical Analytics approvals; have Legal resolve the Open-Meteo/C3S and UCI licence questions and the Eurostat licence; confirm the Valdena coordinates in decisions.md. Attribution text for CC BY sources (Open-Meteo, UCI) goes into outputs. The Chicago link and the AtmosData vendor feed are not feasible and are not needed to meet any must need.
